purpose: Original selected-image prompt provenance; approved motion amendments take precedence.

items.title: Split-Trough Watcher
items.detail: Electricity Age mechanically swept radar. A broad shallow rectangular parabolic trough, visibly split along its center by a heavy receiving spine. Exposed riveted ribs and coarse copper mesh sit in a rotating U-shaped cradle above a squat gear-driven pedestal. A copper transformer and two ceramic insulators stand on the fixed base. Soot-black steel, oxidized copper, one amber indicator. The upper assembly clearly turns around one vertical bearing. Make the trough and visible mechanical rotation the dominant silhouette.
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ESIR Factorio machine concept, one standalone 2D painted illustration. Orthographic isometric view, compact 3-by-3-tile footprint, upper-left illumination and a readable lower-right cast shadow. Center the entire machine in a square composition with generous margins. Clear silhouette at gameplay zoom, worn industrial materials and deliberate mechanical construction, restrained occult-industrial character expressed through severe geometry. Isolated on a plain medium charcoal-grey background. All feet, wiring and moving parts must stay within the footprint. No text, labels, scenery, watermark, people, floating holograms or decorative magic. This is a concept illustration, not a finished spritesheet.

items.title: Fourfold Interrogator
items.detail: Simulation Age fixed phased-array radar. Four thick upright antenna fins radiate from a central armored processor in a rigid cross arrangement. The outward faces have clearly patterned ceramic emitter grids, and copper heat sinks run along the rear edges. Short structural bridges lock each fin to the base; every component is stationary. A small deep-magenta light marks the central seam. Sharply divided silhouette: four industrial blades enclosing the signal-processing core. No weapon barrels or holograms.
